---

This site is written entirely in R + Quarto. Every page, including the [publication list](../../publications.qmd), is rendered from code. A GitHub Actions workflow rebuilds and publishes the site to GitHub Pages whenever I push to `main`.

I'll use this blog for short notes on multilevel modeling, EMA data workflows, and reproducible research practice.
